description: Source file implementing utility functions for distributed RPC agent management in PyTorch, including name collection, synchronization, and worker info handling.

methods.name: collectNames
methods.description: Collects and maps worker names to IDs in a distributed setting.

methods.name: collectCurrentNames
methods.description: Collects current worker names and IDs, updating shared store.

methods.name: removeCurrentName
methods.description: Removes the current worker's name and ID from the shared store.

methods.name: syncCallCount
methods.description: Synchronizes process calls and counts active RPC calls across workers.
